decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the game by using a variety of artifacts and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck includes cards that exile cards from the opponent's graveyard, generate tokens, and provide card advantage. Additionally, the deck includes various land cards to ensure mana stability and consistency. The goal is to outlast the opponent and overwhelm them with a combination of removal spells and powerful creatures to secure victory.

This deck revolves around quickly playing out aggressive creatures and overwhelming the opponent with a strong board presence. The focus is on generating mana efficiently with cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, while also benefiting from cards like Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer to buff up the creatures. The deck also includes some evasion and removal options like Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Demolition Field to maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the strategy is to swarm the board with efficient creatures and win through combat damage.

This deck focuses on playing cheap spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Wild Ride and Stormchaser's Talent to pump up creatures and push through damage. The deck also includes cards like Secret Identity and Boomerang Basics to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent access to both red and blue mana for casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and proactive in order to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and spells to apply constant pressure on the opponent. The key strategy involves using cards like Stormchaser's Talent and Wild Ride to boost the power of creatures like Callous Sell-Sword and Elusive Otter. The deck also features cards like Pym Particles and Secret Identity to protect your creatures and keep up the aggression. By maintaining a fast pace and overwhelming the opponent with multiple threats, the goal is to quickly reduce their life total to zero.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly play low-cost spells and creatures to control the board and deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. Cards like Burst Lightning and Stormchaser's Talent are used to target the opponent's creatures or directly attack their life points. Boomerang Basics and Multiversal Passage provide flexibility and disruption, while Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off offer efficient aggression. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and finish the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to use the aggressive UR (blue-red) archetype to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast spells and creatures. The deck focuses on efficient mana usage and card draw to maintain a consistent pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Burst Lightning, Slickshot Show-Off, and Eddymurk Crab, the goal is to keep the opponent on the back foot and control the tempo of the game. The inclusion of cards like Boomerang Basics and Flow State allows for versatility in dealing with threats and maintaining board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures while using support cards to maintain board control and push for damage. By utilizing mana ramp with Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, this Mono Green Aggro deck aims to quickly deploy threats like Ba Sing Se and Badgermole Cub. Earthbender Ascension and Sazh's Chocobo provide additional combat tricks and evasion, while cards like Demolition Field and Royal Treatment help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy revolves around creating a strong board presence and closing out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on aggression and speed, utilizing a mix of cheap spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By consistently drawing cards and bouncing threats back to the opponent's hand, the deck aims to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy revolves around efficiently deploying threats, protecting them with spells like Secret Identity, and leveraging them with abilities like Stormchaser's Talent. With a mix of evasion and card advantage, this deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can establish a stable board presence.

The main concept of this Jeskai Control deck is to utilize a combination of card draw, removal spells, and powerful control cards to outlast opponents and control the game. By efficiently managing resources and generating card advantage through cards like Abandon Attachments, Accumulate Wisdom, and Jeskai Revelation, the deck aims to maintain board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Additionally, powerful cards like Combustion Technique and Firebending Lesson provide additional removal options and win conditions, making it difficult for opponents to mount an effective offense against the deck.

This deck focuses on using cheap spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Burst Lightning, the strategy is to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game. With a mix of counter spells like Spell Pierce and card draw options like Opt and Sleight of Hand, the deck aims to outpace opponents and finish them off before they can stabilize. Multiversal Passage provides additional flexibility in mana fixing, while Eddymurk Crab and Colorstorm Stallion offer some control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells and abilities. The goal is to assemble a powerful board presence that overwhelms the opponent before they can mount a defense. Key cards like Ardyn, the Usurper and Bringer of the Last Gift provide strong threats that can quickly take over the game. By utilizing cards like Rapid Rescue and Overlord of the Balemurk, this deck aims to create a fast and aggressive strategy that puts pressure on the opponent from the start.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly bring out creatures with efficient mana costs and utilize spell cards to control the board and deal direct damage. By using cards like Opt and Sleight of Hand to draw additional cards and find key pieces, the deck can maintain a high tempo and pressure the opponent early on. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize, utilizing cards like Stormchaser's Talent and Burst Lightning to close out the game.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive green creatures and powerful spells. The key strategy is to ramp up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, allowing for early plays of strong creatures such as Ba Sing Se and Badgermole Cub. Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer provide additional buffs to the creatures, while cards like Meltstrider's Resolve and Escape Tunnel provide evasion and protection. Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Demolition Field offer additional ways to push damage through and close out the game quickly.

This Azorius Aggro deck focuses on early aggression with efficient creatures and disruption spells to control the board and apply pressure on opponents. By utilizing creatures like Aang, Swift Savior and Aven Interrupter alongside cards like Get Lost and Avatar's Wrath, the deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield and quickly close out games. Key cards like Jennifer Walters and Quantum Riddler provide additional card advantage and flexibility, while the mana base of Floodfarm Verge and Hallowed Fountain ensures smooth mana development for consistent threats. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around efficient creatures and disruption to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up a board presence with low-cost creatures and use cards like Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer to buff them up for aggressive attacks. The deck also includes cards for mana ramp, card draw, and ways to protect your creatures, allowing you to maintain pressure on your opponent and finish the game quickly. Additionally, the deck includes Surrak, Elusive Hunter as a powerful finisher and Promising Vein for additional utility. Overall, the focus is on overwhelming your opponent with a fast-paced and powerful mono green aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up your graveyard with powerful creatures, and then bringing them back into play using reanimation effects. By utilizing cards like Bringer of the Last Gift and Overlord of the Balemurk, you can cheat expensive creatures onto the battlefield without paying their mana cost. Cards like Commune with Beavers and Dredger's Insight help you fill up your graveyard, while cards like Town Greeter and Rapid Rescue provide protection and support for your reanimation strategy. With careful planning and timing, you can overwhelm your opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures.
